title: Potential violation of data minimization principle
description: The grading service may process more grade data than is actually needed to build the required views for students, parents, and teachers. This could violate the data minimization principle under GDPR and similar regulations.
assumptions: The service processes all available grade records rather than only those necessary for specific views
uncertainty_note: Depends on implementation details of view generation
